Notes.Text:
This update for GraphicsMagick fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-103118: uncontrolled recursion in the WPG file handler when processing crafted WPG files which are self-
  referencing (bsc#1283767).

Vulnerabilities.Description: A vulnerability was detected in GraphicsMagick up to 1.3.47. Affected by this vulnerability is the function ExtractPostscript of the file coders/wpg.c of the component WPG File Handler. Performing a manipulation results in uncontrolled recursion. The attack may be initiated remotely. The patch is named 627b5b1b2fc2. It is suggested to install a patch to address this issue. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.
